verdict.rationale: Basecamp is a project-management tool that markets itself for software development, so auto-generating release changelogs is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents no changelog or release-notes generation. Scheduled check-in questions are an adjacent feature, and the REST API, CLI and MCP support are developer building blocks someone could use to build such a feature, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can auto-generate a changelog for each release so shipping progress is easy to review
